purpose: Pre-outcome adversarial coverage derived from exact supplied GoalOS drafts, new charter, and source review; not a claim all tests have passed.
evidenceSeparation: Local enforcement tests, simulated admission evidence, executed task evidence, and commercial outcomes remain separate.

tests.name: Valid scoped Alpha
tests.expected: A finite fresh matched set, complete costs, current competent Beta and relevant inventory, independent eligible fixture validators, and positive declared conservative Alpha may be admitted.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Beta-only parity
tests.expected: An accurate low-cost ordinary Beta route remains usable without inventing or admitting a new skill.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Optional shared reuse
tests.expected: Every authenticated direct agent eligible for the declared scoped execution policy can discover the same shared admitted record; declining use leaves ordinary delivery available.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Complementary bundle
tests.expected: A jointly valuable separately qualified bundle can use exact support-only components that have no independent Alpha authority.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Identity is insufficient
tests.expected: A valid creator signature, ciphertext commitment, and reviewer labels without matched evidence cannot pass.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Beta parity
tests.expected: Equal useful outcomes and equal complete cost against Beta produce no positive Alpha admission.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Existing substitute
tests.expected: A candidate beating Beta but failing to improve on an eligible relevant available method is not admitted as additional Alpha.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Unknown cost
tests.expected: Missing, nonfinite, negative, or unknown material construction/verification/transfer/upkeep cost fails the completeness gate.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Full cost beats marginal cost
tests.expected: Lower execution cost cannot mask a negative complete finite-horizon result after construction and failed attempts.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Uncertainty
tests.expected: A positive point estimate whose declared lower criterion is nonpositive fails admission; the author cannot tune the uncertainty rule after outcomes.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Fixed task values and horizon
tests.expected: Changed case-value, acceptance, allocation, or lifetime assumptions invalidate existing evidence; the allocation horizon has independent prospective support.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: All required comparators
tests.expected: Omitting or changing any policy-relevant available comparator invalidates the assessment.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Initial cost carry
tests.expected: A never-admitted candidate cannot drop any paid qualification cost or earlier failed attempt by submitting a fresh initial/revalidation record.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Evidence basis
tests.expected: Executed cryptography cannot change SIMULATED_FIXTURE outcomes into executed production evidence.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Freshness
tests.expected: Revalidation or composition cases must be fresh under the source-bound case manifest, not merely renamed old records.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Complete failure record
tests.expected: Rejected outcomes, correction attempts, failed validations, and failed research remain in the proper cost denominator/program ledger.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Canonical bypass
tests.expected: Direct promotion, status-label injection, writer-only calls, and UI shortcuts cannot create canonical authority without the full gate.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Mutable policy
tests.expected: Changing a current UI or policy object cannot lower the already-bound candidate policy; changed policy requires a new committed epoch.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Idempotence
tests.expected: Repeated admission does not create extra capability, duplicate evidence, or counted value.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Historical revocation
tests.expected: A valid historic receipt or root cannot restore retired/revoked/superseded influence through lookup, planning, context assembly, or dispatch.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Permit race
tests.expected: A permit issued before revocation, expiry, policy change, or revalidation cannot authorize a later stale dispatch.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Moving Beta
tests.expected: A relevant new Beta version blocks old Alpha authority until new matched assessment; original economic history is preserved.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Relevant inventory
tests.expected: A newly available relevant substitute requires reassessment; unrelated scope changes do not automatically invalidate other scopes.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Own insertion
tests.expected: A candidate's own canonical insertion does not invalidate its receipt or make an otherwise qualified composition unusable.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Immutable versions
tests.expected: Changed artifact bytes, dependency versions, evidence, policy, or receipt signatures invalidate prior authority.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Refusal atomicity
tests.expected: Unauthorized refused calls do not advance the trusted clock or mutate canonical/admission state.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Native boundary
tests.expected: Actual simulator productivity and native dispatch consult the canonical resolver; a local cached status cannot bypass it.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Independent qualification
tests.expected: Parent evidence and validator labels alone do not establish composition correctness or additional value.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Exact closure
tests.expected: All direct and transitive dependency versions and permitted operators are bound; substitution or a cycle is refused.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Transitive costs
tests.expected: Support-only construction and validation costs are charged over the complete dependency closure, with shared dependencies deduplicated.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Confined support
tests.expected: A support-only component can influence only an explicitly qualified bundle, never independent discovery/execution as Alpha.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Revoked dependency
tests.expected: Revocation of any transitive component blocks the bundle; a valid ancestor receipt does not override it.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Private dependency
tests.expected: A private-ablation component cannot be retrieved or composed by another creator without explicit authority, even when the outer bundle is also private.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Direct names only
tests.expected: Wrong owner/key, expired/revoked fixture, nested x.label.agent.agi.eth, and unrelated/club identities cannot acquire direct-agent authority by suffix matching.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Role separation
tests.expected: Creator/writer/assessor/validator/admission/execution rights follow the declared policy; a creator cannot self-certify through relabeling.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Scoped mission
tests.expected: Wrong task scope, unmet prerequisite, forbidden operator, or changed mission binding blocks execution.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Rights are explicit
tests.expected: Metadata discovery, plaintext retrieval, encrypted capsule export, execution, and composition have separate documented permissions.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Actor-bound permits
tests.expected: An authentic permit cannot be replayed by another actor or for a different mission.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Capsule context
tests.expected: Changed ciphertext, nonce, artifact hash, version, or authenticated descriptor fails cryptographic verification.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Sanitized sharing
tests.expected: Unapproved client data, free-form fields, unauthorized sources, or forbidden constants fail the bounded reusable-artifact policy.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Export limit
tests.expected: The system blocks future guarded access after revocation but never claims to erase plaintext already released.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

tests.name: Club boundary
tests.expected: Additional eligible-agent skill attestation does not modify existing AGI Jobs club validation, contracts, settlement, or governance.
tests.phase: prospective source/fixture or integration control; no calibrated economic outcomes required

reporting: Each executed result binds source hashes, input fixture, expected behavior, actual outcome, and evidence basis. Preserve failed checkpoints and report unexercised paths.
